surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 3 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Asr (The Declining Day, Epoch) is the 103th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 3 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصالحات وتواصوا بالحق وتواصوا بالصبر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: except for those who believe, do good deeds, urge one another to the truth, and urge one another to steadfastness
